# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.6.11

A small polish release. This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **No crosshair in Pacifism.** Your ship can't fire in Pacifism, so the mouse crosshair (and the cursor) now stay out of the way during a Pacifism round. Every other mode keeps mouse aim as before.

Online leaderboards are live for every mode: switch them on and pick a player name on the launcher's **Gameplay** page, and see how you stack up on the **Everyone** boards.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.6.11-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
